name: @shendeguize/local-sm
description: npm launcher for the LocalSM Python CLI

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p=require('./package.json');const w=fs.readdirSync('./wheel').filter(n=>n==='local_sm-'+p.version+'-py3-none-any.whl');if(w.length!==1)throw new Error('Expected exactly one matching LocalSM wheel in wheel/');"
